prompt.zh-CN: 要比较新旧两个排序模型，评测集应该从哪里来？
prompt.en-US: Comparing an old and a new ranking model: where should the eval set come from?

scenario.en-US: The decision is a full rollout.

text.zh-CN: 从近期真实流量中分层抽样
text.en-US: A stratified sample of recent real traffic

why.zh-CN: 全量切换影响的是真实流量，评测分布要贴近它，分层是为了长尾不被淹没。
why.en-US: A full rollout affects real traffic, so the eval distribution should match it; stratifying keeps the long tail visible.

why.zh-CN: 难例适合诊断，不适合做上线决策，会高估差距。
why.en-US: Hard cases diagnose; for a rollout decision they overstate the gap.

why.zh-CN: 合成数据能补覆盖，但不能代表真实分布。
why.en-US: Synthetic data fills coverage gaps but does not represent the real distribution.

explanation.zh-CN: 决策决定分布：上线决策用真实流量。
explanation.en-US: The decision sets the distribution: rollout decisions use real traffic.

hints.zh-CN: 切换后模型面对的是什么输入？
hints.en-US: What inputs will the model face after the switch?
